metadata.description:
This is a ground report from he Nimad region of Madhya Pradesh. During our interactions with the people of Bhil, Bhilala and Barela Adivasis/tribals, we found that child marriage and polygamy is very common among them. The main reason behind child marriage is bride price. It's an extremely complicated issue facing this society. We try to understand the issue with sensitivity.
